passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: We ask a question, and we do a small experiment.
phrases.ko: 우리는 질문을 하고, 작은 실험을 해요.

phrases.en: I learn about a star, and I want to learn more.
phrases.ko: 나는 별에 대해 배우고, 더 배우고 싶어요.

phrases.en: This subject asks why the sky is blue.
phrases.ko: 이 과목은 하늘이 왜 파란색인지 물어요.

phrases.en: A small experiment can answer a big question.
phrases.ko: 작은 실험이 큰 질문에 답할 수 있어요.

phrases.en: Our teacher lets us look at a picture of a star.
phrases.ko: 선생님은 우리가 별 그림을 보게 해 주세요.

phrases.en: I learn a little more every week.
Science is my favorite subject because I am curious.
phrases.ko: 나는 궁금한 것이 많아서 과학이 내가 가장 좋아하는 과목이에요.

full_passage_spoken: My favorite subject is science. We ask a question, and we do a small experiment. Science is interesting. My teacher makes it fun. I learn about a star, and I want to learn more. This subject asks why the sky is blue. A small experiment can answer a big question. Interesting science is also fun. Our teacher lets us look at a picture of a star. I learn a little more every week. Science is my favorite subject because I am curious.
